additional_info.subject: ID0467758-DC/Si-D/HU-[RVP / T2 170004350] DC1 Errorcode CRM:03056000800
additional_info.body:
Hi Laszlo, good afternoon.
I checked the charger and it seems that KF12 (EcoG LE) is missing from the network which makes the charger unoperational.
I am waiting for SSH access since I don't have access to v6.0.3 and by updating the charger it will come back as v6 since it cannot update the EcoG.
As soon as I know what needs to be done I will send you the steps.
Thank you for your patience so far.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0467758-DC/Si-D/HU-[RVP / T2 170004350] DC1 Errorcode CRM:03056000800

Hi Laszlo,
It seems the charger is already in the latest version. Can you please let me know if you performed any site activity? Otherwise then it seems like a momentary error that recovered.
I will close the ticket since it's resolved.
Thank you and happy New Year!
Best regards,
Francisco
